turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Of course! Let me think out loud with one example first.
I want to say "___ island". I listen to the first sound of "island": it is "ai", a vowel sound. So I choose "an": They live on an island.
The rule: we use "an" before a vowel sound and "a" before other sounds.
Right: My sister has a bike. Wrong: My sister has an bike.

Now it's your turn. Write only the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
